verdict.rationale: Attio is a SaaS CRM, and publishing its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Attio's own source code published under any open license. The public OpenAPI specification and the App SDK are API descriptions and developer building blocks, not the product's source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
